defs.def: producing very clear pictures in your mind 记忆、描述等

ex.s: Informed by neuroaesthetics, the next time I create my art I will value the process even more, enjoying the activation of the aesthetic triad in my brain as I admire the vivid images that I have created.
ex.t: 在神经美学启发下，下次我创作艺术时会更重视过程，享受大脑中审美三联体被激活，同时欣赏我创造的生动图像。

ex.s: Whatever it is, the result is a fine and vivid description of the purest of Central Asian traditions.
ex.t: 无论它是什么，结果都是对最纯粹的中亚传统的一种精致而生动的描绘。

ex.s: It vividly illustrated a dragon playing with a ball.
ex.t: 它生动地描绘了一条龙在玩一个球。

ex.s: But winning gold in Rio paints the most vivid portrait of the team's competitive spirit.
ex.t: 但在里约夺金最生动地描绘了这支队伍的竞技精神。

ex.s: But winning gold in Rio paints the most vivid portrait of the team’s competitive spirit.
ex.t: 但在里约夺金最生动地描绘了这支队伍的竞技精神。

ex.s: By using human characteristics to describe an object, animal or even a place, personification can make descriptions more vivid.
ex.t: 通过使用人类特征来描述一个物体、动物甚至一个地方，拟人化可以使描述更加生动。

ex.s: The words “railways like massive dragons are winding among the mountains” seem particularly vivid as I travel across the “roof of the world”.
ex.t: 当我穿越“世界屋脊”时， “铁路像巨龙一样在山间蜿蜒”这句话似乎特别生动。

defs.def: able to form pictures of ideas, situations, etc. easily in the mind 人的想像
